artifact_licenses_approval_chk.name: artifact_licenses_approval_chk
artifact_licenses_approval_chk.value: not "artifact_licenses"."approved_for_production" or ("artifact_licenses"."commercial_use" = 'allowed' and "artifact_licenses"."source_data_rights_status" = 'known' and "artifact_licenses"."approved_by" is not null)

model_registry_approval_chk.name: model_registry_approval_chk
model_registry_approval_chk.value: not "model_registry"."approved_for_production" or ("model_registry"."commercial_use" = 'allowed' and "model_registry"."approved_by" is not null)

evidence_admitted_complete_chk.name: evidence_admitted_complete_chk
evidence_admitted_complete_chk.value: "evidence_records"."status" <> 'admitted' or ("evidence_records"."license_or_usage_rights" is not null and "evidence_records"."pii_classification" is not null and "evidence_records"."confidence" is not null)

offers_scarcity_chk.name: offers_scarcity_chk
offers_scarcity_chk.value: "offers"."scarcity_claim" is null or "offers"."scarcity_evidence_id" is not null
